arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/project/src'); sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
from harness import ktest, obj
from eywa.offline import execute
types = [
  {"name": "U8", "kind": "int", "bits": 8},
  {"name": "Str", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 3},
  {"name": "Arr", "kind": "array", "element": "U8", "size": 3},
  {"name": "Pair", "kind": "struct", "fields": [["s", "Str"], ["n", "U8"]]},
  {"name": "PairArr", "kind": "array", "element": "Pair", "size": 2},
]
requires = ["all", "e", ["var", "p"], ["match", ["field", ["var", "e"], "s"], "[ab]+"]]
modules = [{"name": "m", "params": [["x", "U8"], ["xs", "Arr"], ["p", "PairArr"]], "result": ["r", "U8"], "requires": requires}]
objs = [obj("x0", 1, 1)]
for i in range(3): objs.append(obj("x%d" % (2+i), 1, 1))
for j,(s,n) in enumerate([("ab",1),("ab",2)]):
    base = 8 + j*6
    for i in range(3): objs.append(obj("x%d" % (base+i), ord(s[i]) if i < len(s) else 0, 1))
    objs.append(obj("x%d" % (base+3), n, 1))
objs.append(obj("x18", 0, 1))
doc = {"types": types, "modules": modules, "calls": [], "pipes": [], "entries": ["m"], "machine": None,
       "runs": [{"entry": "m", "ktest": ktest(objs)}]}
g = execute(doc)
print(json.dumps(g["records"]))
try:
    sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/project/src')
    from eywa.ast import build_types, compile_predicate
    t = build_types(types)
    f = compile_predicate(requires, {"x": t["U8"], "xs": t["Arr"], "p": t["PairArr"]}, t)
    print(f({"p":[{"s":"ab","n":1},{"s":"ab","n":2}],"x":1,"xs":[1,1,1]}))
except Exception as e:
    import traceback; traceback.print_exc()
PYEOF
